BIOLOGY — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BIOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of.

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination in Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Response and Coordination in Animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Response and Coordination in Animals.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Response and Coordination in Animals.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Response and Coordination in Animals.

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Evolution? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Evolution.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Evolution.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Evolution.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Evolution.

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

7. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

8. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Genetics? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Genetics.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Genetics.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Genetics.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Genetics.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Support and Movement in Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Support and Movement in Animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Support and Movement in Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Support and Movement in Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Support and Movement in Animals.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Support in Plants? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Support in Plants.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Support in Plants.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Support in Plants.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Support in Plants.

13. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination in Plants? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Response and Coordination in Plants.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Response and Coordination in Plants.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Response and Coordination in Plants.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Response and Coordination in Plants.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor.

16. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

17. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Glucose and oxygen

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S.

19. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

20. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Overgrazing continuously

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. In three clear sentences, explain Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Response and Coordination in Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
